    const metricKind = kpi => ['emails_enviados', 'emails_entregues', 'quantidade', 'quantidade_retorno', 'pesquisas_disponiveis'].includes(kpi)
      ? 'integer' : ['estrelas', 'nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi) ? 'decimal' : 'percent';
    const informativeRegionLabel = region => {
      const match = normalize(region).match(/^regiao\s*([1-5])$/);
      return match ? `R${match[1]}` : region;
    };
    const summaryExportRows = (channel, keys, selectedRegion = '', search = '', selectedKeys = new Set(), includeAvailable = true) => {
      const columns = metricColumns(channel, includeAvailable);
      const query = normalize(search);
      const filtered = dealers.filter(dealer => {
        const channelData = dealer.canais?.[channel];
        return channelData
          && (!selectedRegion || channelData.regional === selectedRegion)
          && (!selectedKeys.size || selectedKeys.has(dealer.k))
          && (!query || normalize(channelData.grupo).includes(query));
      });
      const exportRows = [];
      const regionMap = new Map();
      filtered.forEach(dealer => {
        const region = dealer.canais[channel].regional || 'Sem regional';
        const group = dealer.canais[channel].grupo || 'Sem grupo';
        if (!regionMap.has(region)) regionMap.set(region, new Map());
        if (!regionMap.get(region).has(group)) regionMap.get(region).set(group, []);
        regionMap.get(region).get(group).push(dealer);
      });
      const appendRow = (bir, label, level, items) => {
        const value = aggregateValues(items, channel, keys);
        value.pesquisas_disponiveis = aggregateAvailableSurveys(items, channel);
        exportRows.push({
          level,
          cells: [
            { v: bir || '-', kind: 'text' },
            { v: label, kind: 'text' },
            ...columns.map(([kpi]) => ({
              v: value[kpi],
              kind: metricKind(kpi),
              state: objectiveClass(channel, kpi, value[kpi]),
            })),
          ],
        });
      };
      [...regionMap.entries()]
        .sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, 'pt-BR'))
        .forEach(([region, groupMap]) => {
          const regionItems = [...groupMap.values()].flat();
          appendRow('-', informativeRegionLabel(region), 'region', regionItems);
          [...groupMap.entries()]
            .sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right, 'pt-BR'))
            .forEach(([group, items]) => {
              appendRow('-', group, 'group', items);
              items
                .sort((left, right) => left.nome.localeCompare(right.nome, 'pt-BR'))
                .forEach(dealer => appendRow(dealer.bir || '-', dealer.nome, 'dealer', [dealer]));
            });
        });
      appendRow('-', 'Total Geral', 'brazil', filtered);
      return exportRows;
    };
    const summarySheet = (channel, periodLabel, keys, selectedRegion = '', search = '', selectedKeys = new Set()) => {
      const columns = metricColumns(channel, false);
      return {
        name: `${periodLabel} ${channel.toUpperCase()}`,
        channel,
        title: `Resumo (Tabelão) · ${channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda'} · ${periodLabel}`,
        subtitle: [
          `Período: ${periodDescription(keys)}`,
          selectedRegion ? `Regional: ${selectedRegion}` : 'Todas as regionais',
          search ? `Grupo: ${search}` : '',
          selectedKeys.size ? `${selectedKeys.size} concessionária(s) selecionada(s)` : '',
          'Arquivo formatado Geely',
        ].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),
        headers: ['BIR', 'Regional / Grupo / Concessionária', ...columns.map(([, label]) => label)],
        widths: [15, 38, ...columns.map(() => 19)],
        rows: summaryExportRows(channel, keys, selectedRegion, search, selectedKeys, false),
      };
    };
    pane.innerHTML = '<div class="dealerx-subtabs general-summary-subtabs"><button class="subtab active" data-channel="vn" data-general-target="vn">Vendas</button><button class="subtab" data-channel="pv" data-general-target="pv">Pós-Venda</button></div><div class="general-summary-pane active" data-general-pane="vn"></div><div class="general-summary-pane" data-general-pane="pv"></div>';

    const setupChannel = channel => {
      const target = pane.querySelector(`[data-general-pane="${channel}"]`);
      let keys = [currentMonth];
      let activePreset = 'mtd';
      let exportRows = [];
      const columns = metricColumns(channel);
      target.innerHTML = `<div class="dealerx-panel channel-${channel}"><div class="dealerx-title ${channel}"><span>Resumo (Tabelão) · ${channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda'}</span><small>Regional → Grupo → Concessionária</small></div><div class="dealerx-toolbar"><div><small>Atalhos</small><div class="dealerx-chips"><button class="dealerx-chip active" data-gpreset="mtd">MTD</button><button class="dealerx-chip" data-gpreset="3m">3M</button><button class="dealerx-chip" data-gpreset="6m">6M</button><button class="dealerx-chip" data-gpreset="ytd">YTD</button></div></div><div><small>Meses</small><div class="dealerx-chips">${months.map(month => `<button class="dealerx-chip ${month.key === currentMonth ? 'active' : ''}" data-gmonth="${month.key}">${escapeHtml(month.label)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div><label>Regional<select data-gregion><option value="">Todas</option>${regionOptions(channel).map(region => `<option value="${escapeHtml(region)}">${escapeHtml(region)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label>${multiFilterHtml('summary', 'Concessionárias', dealerFilterOptions(channel))}<label>Grupo<input data-gsearch type="search" placeholder="Pesquisar grupo"></label><button class="export" data-gcopy>Baixar tabelão Excel</button><button class="primary" data-ginformativo>Informativo</button><span class="dealerx-image-status" data-gstatus role="status" aria-live="polite"></span></div><div class="dealerx-scroll" data-gtable></div></div>`;

      const render = () => {
        const selectedRegion = target.querySelector('[data-gregion]').value;
        const selectedKeys = selectedMultiValues(target, 'summary');
        const query = normalize(target.querySelector('[data-gsearch]').value);
        const filtered = dealers.filter(dealer => {
          const channelData = dealer.canais?.[channel];
          return channelData
            && (!selectedRegion || channelData.regional === selectedRegion)
            && (!selectedKeys.size || selectedKeys.has(dealer.k))
            && (!query || normalize(channelData.grupo).includes(query));
        });
        const rows = [];
        exportRows = [];
        const regionMap = new Map();
        filtered.forEach(dealer => {
          const region = dealer.canais[channel].regional || 'Sem regional';
          const group = dealer.canais[channel].grupo || 'Sem grupo';
          if (!regionMap.has(region)) regionMap.set(region, new Map());
          if (!regionMap.get(region).has(group)) regionMap.get(region).set(group, []);
          regionMap.get(region).get(group).push(dealer);
        });
        const row = (bir, label, level, items) => {
          const value = aggregateValues(items, channel, keys);
          value.pesquisas_disponiveis = aggregateAvailableSurveys(items, channel);
          const visualLabel = level === 'group' ? `↳ ${label}` : level === 'dealer' ? `　↳ ${label}` : label;
          exportRows.push({
            level,
            cells: [
              { v: bir || '-', kind: 'text' },
              { v: label, kind: 'text' },
              ...columns.map(([kpi]) => ({
                v: value[kpi],
                kind: metricKind(kpi),
                state: objectiveClass(channel, kpi, value[kpi]),
              })),
            ],
          });
          return `<tr class="summary-level-${level}"><td>${escapeHtml(bir || '-')}</td><td class="name">${escapeHtml(visualLabel)}</td>${columns.map(([kpi]) => `<td class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, value[kpi])}">${formatValue(value[kpi], kpi)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`;
        };
        [...regionMap.entries()].sort().forEach(([region, groupMap]) => {
          const regionItems = [...groupMap.values()].flat();
          rows.push(row('-', region, 'region', regionItems));
          [...groupMap.entries()].sort().forEach(([group, items]) => {
            rows.push(row('-', group, 'group', items));
            items.sort((left, right) => left.nome.localeCompare(right.nome, 'pt-BR'))
              .forEach(dealer => rows.push(row(dealer.bir || '-', dealer.nome, 'dealer', [dealer])));
          });
        });
        rows.push(row('-', 'Total Geral · Brasil', 'brazil', filtered));
        target.querySelector('[data-gtable]').innerHTML = `<table class="dealerx-table general-summary-table"><thead><tr><th>BIR</th><th>Regional / Grupo / Concessionária</th>${columns.map(([, label]) => `<th>${escapeHtml(label)}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.join('')}</tbody></table>`;
      };
      target.querySelectorAll('[data-gmonth]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const key = button.dataset.gmonth;
        keys = keys.includes(key) ? keys.filter(item => item !== key) : [...keys, key].sort();
        if (!keys.length) keys = [currentMonth];
        activePreset = '';
        target.querySelectorAll('[data-gmonth]').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('active', keys.includes(item.dataset.gmonth)));
        target.querySelectorAll('[data-gpreset]').forEach(item => item.classList.remove('active'));
        render();
      }));
      target.querySelectorAll('[data-gpreset]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        activePreset = button.dataset.gpreset;
        keys = presetMonthKeys(activePreset);
        target.querySelectorAll('[data-gpreset]').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('active', item === button));
        target.querySelectorAll('[data-gmonth]').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('active', keys.includes(item.dataset.gmonth)));
        render();
      }));
      target.querySelector('[data-gregion]').addEventListener('change', render);
      target.querySelector('[data-gsearch]').addEventListener('input', render);
      bindMultiFilter(target, 'summary', render);
      target.querySelector('[data-gcopy]').addEventListener('click', async event => {
        const button = event.currentTarget;
        const status = target.querySelector('[data-gstatus]');
        const original = button.textContent;
        try {
          button.textContent = 'Gerando arquivo...';
          const period = keys.map(key => months.find(month => month.key === key)?.label || key).join(' + ');
          await window.GeelyExcel.downloadReliable([{
            name: channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda',
            channel,
            title: `Resumo (Tabelão) · ${channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda'}`,
            subtitle: `Período: ${period} · Arquivo formatado Geely`,
            headers: ['BIR', 'Regional / Grupo / Concessionária', ...columns.map(([, label]) => label)],
            widths: [15, 38, ...columns.map(() => 19)],
            rows: exportRows,
          }], `Resumo_Geral_${channel.toUpperCase()}_Geely.xlsx`);
          button.textContent = 'Arquivo gerado';
          status.className = 'dealerx-image-status success';
          status.textContent = `Excel formatado baixado com ${exportRows.length} linhas.`;
        } catch (error) {
          button.textContent = 'Falha ao gerar';
          status.className = 'dealerx-image-status error';
          status.textContent = error.message || 'Não foi possível gerar o arquivo.';
        }
        setTimeout(() => { button.textContent = original; }, 1800);
      });
      target.querySelector('[data-ginformativo]').addEventListener('click', async event => {
        const button = event.currentTarget;
        const status = target.querySelector('[data-gstatus]');
        const original = button.textContent;
        try {
          button.disabled = true;
          button.textContent = 'Gerando informativo...';
          status.className = 'dealerx-image-status';
          status.textContent = 'Montando as 8 abas de Vendas e Pós-Venda.';
          const sheets = ['vn', 'pv'].flatMap(sheetChannel => {
            const channelPane = pane.querySelector(`[data-general-pane="${sheetChannel}"]`);
            const selectedRegion = channelPane.querySelector('[data-gregion]').value;
            const search = channelPane.querySelector('[data-gsearch]').value.trim();
            const selectedKeys = selectedMultiValues(channelPane, 'summary');
            return informativePeriods.map(([periodLabel, preset]) => summarySheet(
              sheetChannel,
              periodLabel,
              presetMonthKeys(preset),
              selectedRegion,
              search,
              selectedKeys,
            ));
          });
          const downloadDate = new Date();
          const downloadDatePart = [
            downloadDate.getFullYear(),
            String(downloadDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
            String(downloadDate.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'),
          ].join('_');
          await window.GeelyExcel.downloadReliable(
            sheets,
            `Informativo_Geely_${downloadDatePart}.xlsx`,
          );
          button.textContent = 'Informativo gerado';
          status.className = 'dealerx-image-status success';
          status.textContent = 'Excel gerado com as abas MTD, 3M, 6M e YTD para VN e PV.';
        } catch (error) {
          button.textContent = 'Falha ao gerar';
          status.className = 'dealerx-image-status error';
          status.textContent = error.message || 'Não foi possível gerar o informativo.';
        } finally {
          button.disabled = false;
          setTimeout(() => { button.textContent = original; }, 1800);
        }
      });
      render();
    };
    setupChannel('vn');
    setupChannel('pv');
    pane.querySelectorAll('[data-general-target]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      pane.querySelectorAll('[data-general-target]').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('active', item === button));
      pane.querySelectorAll('[data-general-pane]').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('active', item.dataset.generalPane === button.dataset.generalTarget));
    }));
  }

  setupGeneralSummary();

  function setupEntityDashboardV2() {
    const pane = document.getElementById('dealerx-search');
    if (!pane) return;
    const groups = [...new Set(dealers.flatMap(dealer => Object.values(dealer.canais || {})
      .map(channelData => canonicalGroup(channelData.grupo))))]
      .sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, 'pt-BR'));
    const regions = [...new Set(dealers.flatMap(dealer => Object.values(dealer.canais || {})
      .map(channelData => channelData.regional).filter(Boolean)))]
      .sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, 'pt-BR'));
    let selectedType = 'dealer';
    let selectedKey = '';
    let keys = [currentMonth];
    let exportMode = 'pptx';

    pane.innerHTML = `
      <div class="dealerx-panel dealerx-search-shell entity-dashboard-shell">
        <div class="dealerx-title"><span>Dash Concessionária</span><small>Concessionária · Grupo · Regional · Brasil</small></div>
        <div class="dealerx-search-controls entity-dashboard-controls">
          <label>Visão<select data-entity-type><option value="dealer">Concessionária</option><option value="group">Grupo</option><option value="region">Regional</option><option value="brazil">Brasil</option></select></label>
          <label class="entity-dashboard-search">Pesquisar<input type="search" data-entity-input list="entity-dashboard-options" placeholder="Digite nome ou BIR" autocomplete="off"><datalist id="entity-dashboard-options"></datalist></label>
          <button type="button" class="primary" data-entity-go>Analisar</button>
          <button type="button" class="export" data-entity-ppt>Gerar apresentação PPT</button>
          <button type="button" class="export" data-entity-pdf>Números Rápidos PDF</button>
          <span class="dealerx-image-status" data-entity-status role="status" aria-live="polite"></span>
        </div>
        <div data-entity-result class="dealerx-empty comparison-empty"><strong>Escolha uma concessionária, grupo, regional ou Brasil.</strong><span>Linhas clicáveis dos rankings também abrem esta visão automaticamente.</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="entity-export-modal hidden" data-entity-export-modal role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="entityExportTitle">
        <div class="entity-export-card">
          <button type="button" class="modal-close" data-entity-export-close aria-label="Fechar">×</button>
          <span class="eyebrow">Exportação executiva</span>
          <h3 id="entityExportTitle" data-export-title>Gerar apresentação PowerPoint</h3>
          <p data-export-description>Escolha Brasil, uma regional ou um grupo.</p>
          <label data-export-type-wrap>Visualização<select data-export-type><option value="brazil">Brasil</option><option value="region">Região</option><option value="group">Grupo</option></select></label>
          <label data-export-value-wrap>Seleção<select data-export-value></select></label>
          <div class="entity-export-actions"><button type="button" class="secondary" data-entity-export-cancel>Cancelar</button><button type="button" class="primary" data-entity-export-confirm>Gerar arquivo</button></div>
          <span class="dealerx-image-status" data-export-status role="status" aria-live="polite"></span>
        </div>
      </div>`;

    const typeSelect = pane.querySelector('[data-entity-type]');
    const input = pane.querySelector('[data-entity-input]');
    const datalist = pane.querySelector('#entity-dashboard-options');
    const result = pane.querySelector('[data-entity-result]');
    const status = pane.querySelector('[data-entity-status]');
    const modal = pane.querySelector('[data-entity-export-modal]');
    const exportType = pane.querySelector('[data-export-type]');
    const exportValue = pane.querySelector('[data-export-value]');
    const exportTypeWrap = pane.querySelector('[data-export-type-wrap]');
    const exportValueWrap = pane.querySelector('[data-export-value-wrap]');
    const exportStatus = pane.querySelector('[data-export-status]');
    const portableExport = document.body.classList.contains('portable-export');
    const exportServerOrigin = String(document.body.dataset.exportServer || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
    const exportServerQuery = String(document.body.dataset.exportQuery || '').replace(/^\?/, '');
    if (portableExport) {
      status.className = 'dealerx-image-status';
      status.textContent = 'Imagem, ranking em PDF e Excel funcionam no arquivo. Mantenha o dashboard local aberto para gerar PPT e Resumo PDF.';
    }

    const optionsFor = type => {
      if (type === 'group') return groups.map(group => ({ key: group, label: group, search: normalize(group) }));
      if (type === 'region') return regions.map(region => ({ key: region, label: region, search: normalize(region) }));
      if (type === 'brazil') return [{ key: 'Brasil', label: 'Brasil', search: 'brasil' }];
      return dealers.slice().sort((left, right) => left.nome.localeCompare(right.nome, 'pt-BR'))
        .map(dealer => ({ key: dealer.k, label: `${dealer.nome} · BIR ${dealer.bir || '-'}`, search: normalize(`${dealer.nome} ${dealer.bir || ''} ${dealer.k}`), dealer }));
    };
    let options = optionsFor(selectedType);

    const populateEntityOptions = (keepKey = '') => {
      selectedType = typeSelect.value;
      options = optionsFor(selectedType);
      datalist.innerHTML = options.map(option => `<option value="${escapeHtml(option.label)}"></option>`).join('');
      input.disabled = selectedType === 'brazil';
      input.placeholder = selectedType === 'dealer' ? 'Digite nome ou BIR'
        : selectedType === 'group' ? 'Digite o grupo' : selectedType === 'region' ? 'Digite a regional' : 'Brasil';
      const keep = options.find(option => option.key === keepKey);
      input.value = keep?.label || (selectedType === 'brazil' ? 'Brasil' : '');
      selectedKey = keep?.key || (selectedType === 'brazil' ? 'Brasil' : '');
    };
    const resolveEntity = () => {
      if (selectedType === 'brazil') return options[0];
      const query = normalize(input.value);
      if (!query) return null;
      const exact = options.find(option => normalize(option.label) === query || normalize(option.key) === query
        || (option.dealer && (normalize(option.dealer.nome) === query || normalize(option.dealer.bir) === query)));
      if (exact) return exact;
      const matches = options.filter(option => option.search.includes(query));
      return matches.length === 1 ? matches[0] : null;
    };
    const itemsFor = (type, key, channel) => dealers.filter(dealer => {
      const channelData = dealer.canais?.[channel];
      if (!channelData) return false;
      if (type === 'dealer') return dealer.k === key;
      if (type === 'group') return canonicalGroup(channelData.grupo) === key;
      if (type === 'region') return channelData.regional === key;
      return true;
    });
    const entityLabel = (type, key) => type === 'dealer'
      ? dealers.find(dealer => dealer.k === key)?.nome || key
      : type === 'brazil' ? 'Brasil' : key;
    const entityDescription = (type, key) => {
      if (type !== 'dealer') return type === 'group' ? 'Resultado consolidado do grupo'
        : type === 'region' ? 'Resultado consolidado da regional' : 'Resultado consolidado Brasil';
      const dealer = dealers.find(item => item.k === key);
      const channelData = dealer?.canais?.vn || dealer?.canais?.pv || {};
      return `BIR ${dealer?.bir || '-'} · ${channelData.regional || 'Sem regional'} · ${canonicalGroup(channelData.grupo)}`;
    };
    const currentGroup = () => {
      if (selectedType === 'group') return selectedKey;
      if (selectedType !== 'dealer') return '';
      const dealer = dealers.find(item => item.k === selectedKey);
      const channelData = dealer?.canais?.vn || dealer?.canais?.pv;
      return channelData ? canonicalGroup(channelData.grupo) : '';
    };

    const renderChart = () => {
      const width = 1100, height = 320, pad = 52;
      const x = index => pad + index * (width - pad * 2) / Math.max(1, months.length - 1);
      const y = value => height - pad - (value + 100) / 200 * (height - pad * 2);
      let svg = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="img" aria-label="Evolução mensal do NPS Index">`;
      [-100, -50, 0, 50, 100].forEach(value => {
        svg += `<line x1="${pad}" y1="${y(value)}" x2="${width - pad}" y2="${y(value)}" stroke="#dfe6e9"/><text x="7" y="${y(value) + 4}" font-size="11">${value}%</text>`;
      });
      ['vn', 'pv'].forEach(channel => {
        const items = itemsFor(selectedType, selectedKey, channel);
        if (!items.length) return;
        const color = channel === 'vn' ? '#0067a0' : '#6d757a';
        const points = months.map((month, index) => ({ index, value: aggregateValues(items, channel, [month.key]).nps_index }))
          .filter(point => point.value != null);
        if (points.length) svg += `<polyline fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="3.5" points="${points.map(point => `${x(point.index)},${y(point.value)}`).join(' ')}"/>`;
        points.forEach(point => { svg += `<circle cx="${x(point.index)}" cy="${y(point.value)}" r="4.5" fill="#fff" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="3"/><text class="dealerx-chart-data-text" x="${x(point.index)}" y="${y(point.value) - 10}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${color}">${channel.toUpperCase()}: ${Number(point.value).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}%</text>`; });
      });
      months.forEach((month, index) => { svg += `<text x="${x(index)}" y="${height - 14}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11">${escapeHtml(month.label)}</text>`; });
      return `${svg}</svg>`;
    };

    const render = () => {
      const option = resolveEntity();
      if (!option) {
        result.className = 'dealerx-empty comparison-empty';
        result.innerHTML = '<strong>Resultado não encontrado ou ambíguo.</strong><span>Digite mais detalhes ou selecione uma opção da lista.</span>';
        return;
      }
      selectedKey = option.key;
      input.value = option.label;
      const label = entityLabel(selectedType, selectedKey);
      const channelBlocks = ['vn', 'pv'].map(channel => {
        const items = itemsFor(selectedType, selectedKey, channel);
        const metadata = data.canais?.[channel] || {};
        if (!items.length) return `<section class="dealerx-channel ${channel}"><h4>${channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda'}</h4><div class="dealerx-empty">Sem unidade disponível neste canal.</div></section>`;
        const value = aggregateValues(items, channel, keys);
        const cards = (metadata.kpis || []).filter(kpi => kpi !== 'quantidade').map(kpi => `
          <div class="dealerx-kpi ${kpi === 'nps_index' ? 'principal' : ''}"><span>${escapeHtml(metadata.rotulos?.[kpi] || kpi)}</span><strong class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, value[kpi])}">${formatValue(value[kpi], kpi)}</strong><small>Objetivo: ${metadata.objetivos?.[kpi] == null ? 'sem objetivo' : formatValue(metadata.objetivos[kpi], kpi)}</small></div>`).join('');
        return `<section class="dealerx-channel ${channel}"><h4>${metadata.label} · ${escapeHtml(periodDescription(keys))}</h4><div class="dealerx-kpi-grid">${cards}<div class="dealerx-kpi"><span>Qtnd de pesquisas</span><strong>${formatValue(value.quantidade, 'quantidade')}</strong></div></div></section>`;
      }).join('');
      result.className = 'dealerx-entity-result';
      result.innerHTML = `<div class="dealerx-search-head"><div><h3>${escapeHtml(label)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(entityDescription(selectedType, selectedKey))}</p></div><span class="entity-view-badge">${selectedType === 'dealer' ? 'Concessionária' : selectedType === 'group' ? 'Grupo' : selectedType === 'region' ? 'Regional' : 'Brasil'}</span></div><div class="dealerx-toolbar entity-period-toolbar"><div><small>Período da análise</small><div class="dealerx-chips">${months.map(month => `<button class="dealerx-chip ${keys.includes(month.key) ? 'active' : ''}" data-entity-month="${month.key}">${escapeHtml(month.label)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div><button class="secondary" data-entity-preset="mtd">MTD</button><button class="secondary" data-entity-preset="h2">H2</button><button class="secondary" data-entity-preset="ytd">YTD</button></div><div class="dealerx-channel-grid">${channelBlocks}</div><div class="dealerx-chart entity-evolution-chart"><div class="entity-chart-heading"><strong>Evolução mensal · NPS Index</strong><span><i class="legend-vn"></i>VN <i class="legend-pv"></i>PV</span></div>${renderChart()}</div>`;
      result.querySelectorAll('[data-entity-month]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const month = button.dataset.entityMonth;
        keys = keys.includes(month) ? keys.filter(key => key !== month) : [...keys, month].sort();
        if (!keys.length) keys = [currentMonth];
        render();
      }));
      result.querySelectorAll('[data-entity-preset]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const preset = button.dataset.entityPreset;
        keys = preset === 'h2' ? secondHalfKeys : presetMonthKeys(preset);
        render();
      }));
    };

    const responseFileName = (response, fallback) => {
      const disposition = response.headers.get('Content-Disposition') || '';
      const utf8 = disposition.match(/filename\*=UTF-8''([^;]+)/i);
      const normal = disposition.match(/filename="?([^";]+)"?/i);
      try { return utf8 ? decodeURIComponent(utf8[1]) : (normal?.[1] || fallback); }
      catch (_) { return fallback; }
    };
    const downloadServerFile = async (endpoint, payload, fallback) => {
      if (portableExport && !exportServerOrigin) throw new Error('Este HTML não possui o endereço do dashboard local. Exporte uma nova cópia pelo aplicativo.');
      if (!portableExport && !/^https?:$/.test(window.location?.protocol || '')) throw new Error('Esta exportação está disponível ao abrir o dashboard pelo servidor Flask.');
      const base = portableExport ? exportServerOrigin : '';
      const query = portableExport ? exportServerQuery : String(window.location.search || '').replace(/^\?/, '');
      let response;
      try {
        response = await fetch(`${base}${endpoint}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`, {
          method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, cache: 'no-store', body: JSON.stringify(payload),
        });
      } catch (_) {
        throw new Error('Não foi possível acessar o dashboard local. Abra o aplicativo e tente novamente.');
      }
      if (!response.ok) {
        const body = await response.text(); let detail = body;
        try { detail = JSON.parse(body).erro || body; } catch (_) {}
        throw new Error(detail || 'Não foi possível gerar o arquivo.');
      }
      const blob = await response.blob();
      if (!blob.size) throw new Error('O servidor devolveu um arquivo vazio.');
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url; link.download = responseFileName(response, fallback); link.rel = 'noopener';
      document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); link.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 5000);
    };

    const refreshExportValue = () => {
      const type = exportMode === 'pdf' ? 'group' : exportType.value;
      const values = type === 'group' ? groups : type === 'region' ? regions : ['Brasil'];
      exportValue.innerHTML = values.map(value => `<option value="${escapeHtml(value)}">${escapeHtml(value)}</option>`).join('');
      exportValueWrap.classList.toggle('hidden', type === 'brazil');
      const preferred = exportMode === 'pdf' ? currentGroup()
        : type === 'group' ? currentGroup() : selectedType === type ? selectedKey : '';
      if (preferred && values.includes(preferred)) exportValue.value = preferred;
    };
    const openExportModal = mode => {
      exportMode = mode;
      exportStatus.textContent = '';
      exportStatus.className = 'dealerx-image-status';
      pane.querySelector('[data-export-title]').textContent = mode === 'pptx' ? 'Gerar apresentação PowerPoint' : 'Gerar PDF de Números Rápidos';
      pane.querySelector('[data-export-description]').textContent = mode === 'pptx'
        ? 'Escolha Brasil, uma regional ou um grupo. O arquivo seguirá o Tamplate.pptx.'
        : 'Escolha o grupo que será usado nos rankings e no gráfico de evolução.';
      exportTypeWrap.classList.toggle('hidden', mode === 'pdf');
      if (mode === 'pdf') exportType.value = 'group';
      else if (['group', 'region', 'brazil'].includes(selectedType)) exportType.value = selectedType;
      else exportType.value = currentGroup() ? 'group' : 'brazil';
      refreshExportValue();
      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.querySelector('[data-entity-export-confirm]').focus();
    };
    const closeExportModal = () => modal.classList.add('hidden');
    exportType.addEventListener('change', refreshExportValue);
    pane.querySelector('[data-entity-export-close]').addEventListener('click', closeExportModal);
    pane.querySelector('[data-entity-export-cancel]').addEventListener('click', closeExportModal);
    modal.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => { if (event.target === modal) closeExportModal(); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && !modal.classList.contains('hidden')) closeExportModal();
    });
    pane.querySelector('[data-entity-export-confirm]').addEventListener('click', async event => {
      const button = event.currentTarget;
      const original = button.textContent;
      try {
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = exportMode === 'pptx' ? 'Gerando apresentação...' : 'Gerando PDF...';
        exportStatus.textContent = exportMode === 'pptx' ? 'Montando tabelas, rankings, gráficos e verbalizações.' : 'Montando os Números Rápidos do grupo.';
        if (exportMode === 'pptx') {
          const scopeType = exportType.value;
          const scopeValue = scopeType === 'brazil' ? 'Brasil' : exportValue.value;
          await downloadServerFile('/exportar/apresentacao-pptx', { scope_type: scopeType, scope_value: scopeValue }, 'Dados_Geely.pptx');
        } else {
          if (!exportValue.value) throw new Error('Selecione um grupo.');
          await downloadServerFile('/exportar/numeros-rapidos-pdf', { group: exportValue.value }, 'ResumoDados_Grupo.pdf');
        }
        exportStatus.className = 'dealerx-image-status success';
        exportStatus.textContent = 'Arquivo gerado e enviado para download.';
        button.textContent = 'Arquivo gerado';
        setTimeout(closeExportModal, 900);
      } catch (error) {
        exportStatus.className = 'dealerx-image-status error';
        exportStatus.textContent = error.message || 'Não foi possível gerar o arquivo.';
        button.textContent = 'Falha ao gerar';
      } finally {
        button.disabled = false;
        setTimeout(() => { button.textContent = original; }, 1800);
      }
    });

    typeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
      populateEntityOptions();
      if (selectedType === 'brazil') render();
      else {
        result.className = 'dealerx-empty comparison-empty';
        result.innerHTML = `<strong>Escolha ${selectedType === 'dealer' ? 'uma concessionária' : selectedType === 'group' ? 'um grupo' : 'uma regional'}.</strong><span>Use a pesquisa acima ou clique em uma linha dos rankings.</span>`;
      }
    });
    pane.querySelector('[data-entity-go]').addEventListener('click', render);
    input.addEventListener('keydown', event => { if (event.key === 'Enter') render(); });
    pane.querySelector('[data-entity-ppt]').addEventListener('click', () => openExportModal('pptx'));
    pane.querySelector('[data-entity-pdf]').addEventListener('click', () => openExportModal('pdf'));

    const activatePane = () => {
      document.querySelector('[data-tab-target="ranking"]')?.click();
      document.querySelector('[data-dealerx-target="search"]')?.click();
    };
    window.geelyOpenEntityDashboard = (type, key) => {
      const normalizedType = ['dealer', 'group', 'region', 'brazil'].includes(type) ? type : 'dealer';
      activatePane();
      typeSelect.value = normalizedType;
      populateEntityOptions(key);
      const option = options.find(item => item.key === key || normalize(item.key) === normalize(key));
      if (option) { input.value = option.label; selectedKey = option.key; }
      render();
      pane.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    };
    document.addEventListener('click', event => {
      const row = event.target.closest('[data-open-dashboard-type][data-open-dashboard-key]');
      if (!row || row.dataset.motsBrasil === 'true') return;
      window.geelyOpenEntityDashboard(row.dataset.openDashboardType, row.dataset.openDashboardKey);
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (!['Enter', ' '].includes(event.key)) return;
      const row = event.target.closest('[data-open-dashboard-type][data-open-dashboard-key]');
      if (!row || row.dataset.motsBrasil === 'true') return;
      event.preventDefault();
      window.geelyOpenEntityDashboard(row.dataset.openDashboardType, row.dataset.openDashboardKey);
    });
    populateEntityOptions();
  }

  setupEntityDashboardV2();

  function setupEntityComparison() {
    const pane = document.getElementById('dealerx-comparison');
    if (!pane) return;
    let keys = [currentMonth];
    const groups = [...new Set(dealers.flatMap(dealer => Object.values(dealer.canais || {})
      .map(channelData => canonicalGroup(channelData.grupo))))]
      .sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, 'pt-BR'));
    pane.innerHTML = `
      <div class="dealerx-panel dealerx-search-shell">
        <div class="dealerx-title"><span>Pesquisar e comparar resultados</span><small>Concessionária ou grupo</small></div>
        <div class="dealerx-search-controls comparison-controls">
          <label>Tipo<select data-compare-type><option value="dealer">Concessionárias</option><option value="group">Grupos</option></select></label>
          <label>Resultado A<select data-compare-a></select></label>
          <label>Comparar com (opcional)<select data-compare-b></select></label>
          <button type="button" class="primary" data-compare-go>Exibir resultado</button>
        </div>
        <div class="dealerx-toolbar comparison-periods"><div><small>Período</small><div class="dealerx-chips">
          <button class="dealerx-chip active" data-compare-period="mtd">MTD</button>
          <button class="dealerx-chip" data-compare-period="3m">3M</button>
          <button class="dealerx-chip" data-compare-period="6m">6M</button>
          <button class="dealerx-chip" data-compare-period="ytd">YTD</button>
        </div></div></div>
        <div data-compare-result class="dealerx-empty">Selecione uma concessionária ou altere o tipo para pesquisar um grupo.</div>
      </div>`;
    const typeSelect = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-type]');
    const leftSelect = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-a]');
    const rightSelect = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-b]');
    const result = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-result]');
    const optionData = type => type === 'group'
      ? groups.map(group => ({ value: group, label: group }))
      : dealers
        .slice()
        .sort((left, right) => left.nome.localeCompare(right.nome, 'pt-BR'))
        .map(dealer => ({ value: dealer.k, label: `${dealer.nome} · BIR ${dealer.bir || '-'}` }));
    const populate = () => {
      const options = optionData(typeSelect.value);
      const html = `<option value="">Selecione...</option>${options.map(option => `<option value="${escapeHtml(option.value)}">${escapeHtml(option.label)}</option>`).join('')}`;
      leftSelect.innerHTML = html;
      rightSelect.innerHTML = `<option value="">Sem comparação</option>${options.map(option => `<option value="${escapeHtml(option.value)}">${escapeHtml(option.label)}</option>`).join('')}`;
      result.className = 'dealerx-empty';
      result.textContent = typeSelect.value === 'group'
        ? 'Selecione um grupo para consultar o resultado consolidado.'
        : 'Selecione uma concessionária para consultar o resultado.';
    };
    const entityItems = (type, key, channel) => {
      if (!key) return [];
      return dealers.filter(dealer => dealer.canais?.[channel] && (
        type === 'group'
          ? canonicalGroup(dealer.canais[channel].grupo) === key
          : dealer.k === key
      ));
    };
    const entityName = (type, key) => type === 'group'
      ? key
      : dealers.find(dealer => dealer.k === key)?.nome || key;
    const deltaText = (kpi, left, right) => {
      if (left == null || right == null) return '-';
      const difference = Number(left) - Number(right);
      const sign = difference > 0 ? '+' : '';
      if (['quantidade', 'emails_enviados', 'emails_entregues', 'quantidade_retorno'].includes(kpi)) {
        return `${sign}${Math.round(difference).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}`;
      }
      if (['estrelas', 'nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi)) return `${sign}${difference.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}`;
      return `${sign}${difference.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} p.p.`;
    };
    const deltaClass = (channel, kpi, left, right) => {
      if (left == null || right == null || Number(left) === Number(right)) return 'neutral';
      const lowerIsBetter = (data.canais?.[channel]?.menor_melhor || []).includes(kpi);
      const leftIsBetter = lowerIsBetter ? Number(left) < Number(right) : Number(left) > Number(right);
      return leftIsBetter ? 'good' : 'bad';
    };
    const render = () => {
      const type = typeSelect.value;
      const leftKey = leftSelect.value;
      const rightKey = rightSelect.value;
      if (!leftKey) {
        result.className = 'dealerx-empty';
        result.textContent = type === 'group' ? 'Selecione um grupo.' : 'Selecione uma concessionária.';
        return;
      }
      const leftName = entityName(type, leftKey);
      const rightName = entityName(type, rightKey);
      const channelBlocks = ['vn', 'pv'].map(channel => {
        const leftItems = entityItems(type, leftKey, channel);
        const rightItems = entityItems(type, rightKey, channel);
        if (!leftItems.length && !rightItems.length) return '';
        const leftValue = leftItems.length ? aggregateValues(leftItems, channel, keys) : {};
        const rightValue = rightItems.length ? aggregateValues(rightItems, channel, keys) : {};
        const metadata = data.canais[channel] || {};
        const kpis = metadata.kpis || [];
        const rows = kpis.map(kpi => `<tr><td class="name">${escapeHtml(metadata.rotulos?.[kpi] || kpi)}</td><td class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, leftValue[kpi])}">${formatValue(leftValue[kpi], kpi)}</td>${rightKey ? `<td class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, rightValue[kpi])}">${formatValue(rightValue[kpi], kpi)}</td><td class="${deltaClass(channel, kpi, leftValue[kpi], rightValue[kpi])}">${deltaText(kpi, leftValue[kpi], rightValue[kpi])}</td>` : ''}</tr>`).join('');
        return `<section class="dealerx-channel ${channel} comparison-channel"><h4>${channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda'} · ${escapeHtml(periodDescription(keys))}</h4><div class="dealerx-scroll"><table class="dealerx-table comparison-table"><thead><tr><th>Indicador</th><th>${escapeHtml(leftName)}</th>${rightKey ? `<th>${escapeHtml(rightName)}</th><th>Diferença A − B</th>` : ''}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table></div></section>`;
      }).join('');
      result.className = 'dealerx-comparison-result';
      result.innerHTML = `<div class="dealerx-search-head"><div><h3>${rightKey ? 'Comparação' : 'Resultado'} · ${type === 'group' ? 'Grupo' : 'Concessionária'}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(leftName)}${rightKey ? ` versus ${escapeHtml(rightName)}` : ''}</p></div></div><div class="dealerx-channel-grid">${channelBlocks || '<div class="dealerx-empty">Nenhum resultado para o período.</div>'}</div>`;
    };
    typeSelect.addEventListener('change', populate);
    pane.querySelector('[data-compare-go]').addEventListener('click', render);
    [leftSelect, rightSelect].forEach(select => select.addEventListener('change', render));
    pane.querySelectorAll('[data-compare-period]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      keys = presetMonthKeys(button.dataset.comparePeriod);
      pane.querySelectorAll('[data-compare-period]').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('active', item === button));
      render();
    }));
    populate();
  }

  function setupEntityComparisonV2() {
    const pane = document.getElementById('dealerx-comparison');
    if (!pane) return;
    let activePeriod = 'mtd';
    let keys = presetMonthKeys(activePeriod);
    pane.innerHTML = `
      <div class="dealerx-panel comparison-shell">
        <div class="dealerx-title"><span>Comparativo de performance</span><small>Concessionária ou grupo</small></div>
        <div class="comparison-control-surface">
          <div class="dealerx-search-controls comparison-controls">
            <label>Tipo<select data-compare-type><option value="dealer">Concessionárias</option><option value="group">Grupos</option></select></label>
            <label class="comparison-search-field">Resultado A<input type="search" data-compare-a list="compare-options-a" placeholder="Pesquise nome ou BIR" autocomplete="off"><datalist id="compare-options-a"></datalist></label>
            <label class="comparison-search-field">Resultado B · opcional<input type="search" data-compare-b list="compare-options-b" placeholder="Pesquise para comparar" autocomplete="off"><datalist id="compare-options-b"></datalist></label>
            <button type="button" class="secondary comparison-swap" data-compare-swap disabled>Trocar A ↔ B</button>
            <button type="button" class="primary" data-compare-go>Analisar</button>
            <button type="button" class="export" data-compare-copy disabled>Copiar comparativo</button>
          </div>
          <div class="dealerx-toolbar comparison-periods"><div><small>Período</small><div class="dealerx-chips">
            <button class="dealerx-chip active" data-compare-period="mtd">MTD</button>
            <button class="dealerx-chip" data-compare-period="3m">3M</button>
            <button class="dealerx-chip" data-compare-period="6m">6M</button>
            <button class="dealerx-chip" data-compare-period="ytd">YTD</button>
          </div></div><span class="comparison-period-badge" data-compare-period-label>MTD · ${escapeHtml(periodDescription(keys))}</span></div>
        </div>
        <div data-compare-result class="dealerx-empty comparison-empty"><strong>Escolha o resultado A para começar.</strong><span>Você pode analisar uma unidade sozinha ou comparar duas lado a lado.</span></div>
      </div>`;

    const typeSelect = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-type]');
    const leftInput = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-a]');
    const rightInput = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-b]');
    const leftList = pane.querySelector('#compare-options-a');
    const rightList = pane.querySelector('#compare-options-b');
    const swapButton = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-swap]');
    const copyButton = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-copy]');
    const result = pane.querySelector('[data-compare-result]');
    let options = [];

    const optionData = type => type === 'group'
      ? [...new Set(dealers.flatMap(dealer => Object.values(dealer.canais || {})
        .map(channelData => canonicalGroup(channelData.grupo))))]
        .sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right, 'pt-BR'))
        .map(group => ({ key: group, label: group, search: normalize(group) }))
      : dealers.slice().sort((left, right) => left.nome.localeCompare(right.nome, 'pt-BR'))
        .map(dealer => ({
          key: dealer.k,
          label: `${dealer.nome} · BIR ${dealer.bir || '-'}`,
          search: normalize(`${dealer.nome} ${dealer.bir || ''}`),
        }));
    const populate = () => {
      options = optionData(typeSelect.value);
      const html = options.map(option => `<option value="${escapeHtml(option.label)}"></option>`).join('');
      leftList.innerHTML = html;
      rightList.innerHTML = html;
      leftInput.value = '';
      rightInput.value = '';
      swapButton.disabled = true;
      copyButton.disabled = true;
      result.className = 'dealerx-empty comparison-empty';
      result.innerHTML = `<strong>Escolha ${typeSelect.value === 'group' ? 'um grupo' : 'uma concessionária'} para começar.</strong><span>A pesquisa aceita nome ou BIR.</span>`;
    };
    const resolveOption = input => {
      const query = normalize(input.value);
      if (!query) return { key: '', option: null, ambiguous: false };
      const exact = options.find(option => normalize(option.label) === query || normalize(option.key) === query);
      if (exact) return { key: exact.key, option: exact, ambiguous: false };
      const matches = options.filter(option => option.search.includes(query));
      return matches.length === 1
        ? { key: matches[0].key, option: matches[0], ambiguous: false }
        : { key: '', option: null, ambiguous: matches.length > 1 };
    };
    const entityItems = (type, key, channel) => {
      if (!key) return [];
      return dealers.filter(dealer => dealer.canais?.[channel] && (
        type === 'group'
          ? canonicalGroup(dealer.canais[channel].grupo) === key
          : dealer.k === key
      ));
    };
    const deltaText = (kpi, left, right) => {
      if (left == null || right == null) return '-';
      const difference = Number(left) - Number(right);
      const sign = difference > 0 ? '+' : '';
      if (['quantidade', 'emails_enviados', 'emails_entregues', 'quantidade_retorno'].includes(kpi)) {
        return `${sign}${Math.round(difference).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}`;
      }
      if (['estrelas', 'nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi)) return `${sign}${difference.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}`;
      return `${sign}${difference.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} p.p.`;
    };
    const deltaClass = (channel, kpi, left, right) => {
      if (left == null || right == null || Number(left) === Number(right)) return 'neutral';
      const lowerIsBetter = (data.canais?.[channel]?.menor_melhor || []).includes(kpi);
      const leftIsBetter = lowerIsBetter ? Number(left) < Number(right) : Number(left) > Number(right);
      return leftIsBetter ? 'good' : 'bad';
    };
    const barWidth = (value, kpi, peer) => {
      if (value == null) return 0;
      if (['quantidade', 'emails_enviados', 'emails_entregues', 'quantidade_retorno'].includes(kpi)) {
        return Math.max(4, Math.min(100, Number(value) / Math.max(1, Number(value), Number(peer || 0)) * 100));
      }
      if (['estrelas', 'nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi)) return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(value) / 5 * 100));
      if (kpi.startsWith('nps_')) return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (Number(value) + 100) / 2));
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(value)));
    };
    const comparisonCard = (channel, kpi, label, leftValue, rightValue, hasRight) => `
      <article class="comparison-kpi-card">
        <div class="comparison-kpi-head"><span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span>${hasRight ? `<strong class="comparison-delta ${deltaClass(channel, kpi, leftValue, rightValue)}">${deltaText(kpi, leftValue, rightValue)}</strong>` : ''}</div>
        <div class="comparison-measure"><span>A</span><strong class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, leftValue)}">${formatValue(leftValue, kpi)}</strong><i><b style="--comparison-width:${barWidth(leftValue, kpi, rightValue)}%"></b></i></div>
        ${hasRight ? `<div class="comparison-measure secondary-measure"><span>B</span><strong class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, rightValue)}">${formatValue(rightValue, kpi)}</strong><i><b style="--comparison-width:${barWidth(rightValue, kpi, leftValue)}%"></b></i></div>` : ''}
      </article>`;

    const render = () => {
      const type = typeSelect.value;
      const left = resolveOption(leftInput);
      const right = resolveOption(rightInput);
      if (!left.key) {
        result.className = 'dealerx-empty comparison-empty';
        result.innerHTML = `<strong>${left.ambiguous ? 'Há mais de um resultado com esse texto.' : 'Selecione um resultado A válido.'}</strong><span>${left.ambiguous ? 'Digite mais detalhes do nome ou o BIR.' : 'Use a pesquisa para localizar a unidade ou o grupo.'}</span>`;
        copyButton.disabled = true;
        return;
      }
      if (rightInput.value.trim() && !right.key) {
        result.className = 'dealerx-empty comparison-empty';
        result.innerHTML = `<strong>${right.ambiguous ? 'O resultado B está ambíguo.' : 'O resultado B não foi encontrado.'}</strong><span>Refine o nome ou apague o campo para analisar apenas A.</span>`;
        copyButton.disabled = true;
        return;
      }
      const hasRight = Boolean(right.key);
      if (left.option) leftInput.value = left.option.label;
      if (right.option) rightInput.value = right.option.label;
      swapButton.disabled = !hasRight;
      const leftName = left.option?.label || left.key;
      const rightName = right.option?.label || right.key;
      const keyMetrics = ['nps_index', 'quantidade', 'taxa_resposta', 'data_quality'];
      const channelBlocks = ['vn', 'pv'].map(channel => {
        const leftItems = entityItems(type, left.key, channel);
        const rightItems = entityItems(type, right.key, channel);
        const leftValue = aggregateValues(leftItems, channel, keys);
        const rightValue = hasRight ? aggregateValues(rightItems, channel, keys) : {};
        const metadata = data.canais[channel] || {};
        const kpis = metadata.kpis || [];
        const comparable = kpis.filter(kpi => metadata.objetivos?.[kpi] != null
          && leftValue[kpi] != null && rightValue[kpi] != null);
        let leftWins = 0;
        let rightWins = 0;
        let ties = 0;
        comparable.forEach(kpi => {
          if (Number(leftValue[kpi]) === Number(rightValue[kpi])) ties += 1;
          else if (deltaClass(channel, kpi, leftValue[kpi], rightValue[kpi]) === 'good') leftWins += 1;
          else rightWins += 1;
        });
        const insight = hasRight
          ? `A lidera em ${leftWins} indicador${leftWins === 1 ? '' : 'es'}; B em ${rightWins}; ${ties} empate${ties === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`
          : 'Resultado individual com cores comparadas às metas do canal.';
        const cards = keyMetrics.filter(kpi => kpis.includes(kpi)).map(kpi => comparisonCard(
          channel,
          kpi,
          metadata.rotulos?.[kpi] || kpi,
          leftValue[kpi],
          rightValue[kpi],
          hasRight,
        )).join('');
        const rows = kpis.map(kpi => `<tr><td class="name">${escapeHtml(metadata.rotulos?.[kpi] || kpi)}</td><td class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, leftValue[kpi])}">${formatValue(leftValue[kpi], kpi)}</td>${hasRight ? `<td class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, rightValue[kpi])}">${formatValue(rightValue[kpi], kpi)}</td><td class="${deltaClass(channel, kpi, leftValue[kpi], rightValue[kpi])}">${deltaText(kpi, leftValue[kpi], rightValue[kpi])}</td>` : ''}</tr>`).join('');
        return `<section class="comparison-channel-card channel-${channel}"><div class="dealerx-title ${channel}"><span>${channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda'}</span><small>${escapeHtml(activePeriod.toUpperCase())}</small></div><p class="comparison-insight">${escapeHtml(insight)}</p><div class="comparison-kpi-grid">${cards}</div><details class="comparison-details"><summary>Ver todos os indicadores</summary><div class="dealerx-scroll"><table class="dealerx-table comparison-table"><thead><tr><th>Indicador</th><th>Resultado A</th>${hasRight ? '<th>Resultado B</th><th>Diferença A − B</th>' : ''}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table></div></details></section>`;
      }).join('');
      result.className = 'dealerx-comparison-result';
      result.innerHTML = `<div class="comparison-hero"><article class="comparison-entity-card entity-a"><span>Resultado A</span><strong>${escapeHtml(leftName)}</strong></article><div class="comparison-versus">${hasRight ? 'versus' : 'análise'}</div>${hasRight ? `<article class="comparison-entity-card entity-b"><span>Resultado B</span><strong>${escapeHtml(rightName)}</strong></article>` : `<article class="comparison-entity-card entity-period"><span>Período</span><strong>${escapeHtml(activePeriod.toUpperCase())}</strong></article>`}</div><div class="comparison-channel-grid">${channelBlocks}</div>`;
      copyButton.disabled = false;
    };

    const copyComparison = async () => {
      const tables = [...result.querySelectorAll('.comparison-table')];
      if (!tables.length) return;
      const original = copyButton.textContent;
      const text = tables.map(table => tableText(table)).join('\n\n');
      const html = `<meta charset="utf-8">${tables.map(table => `<table border="1" style="border-collapse:collapse;font-family:Calibri,Arial,sans-serif">${table.innerHTML}</table>`).join('<br>')}`;
      try {
        if (navigator.clipboard?.write && typeof ClipboardItem === 'function') {
          await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({
            'text/html': new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' }),
            'text/plain': new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' }),
          })]);
        } else if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        else throw new Error('Cópia não suportada');
        copyButton.textContent = 'Comparativo copiado';
      } catch (_) {
        copyButton.textContent = 'Cópia bloqueada';
      }
      setTimeout(() => { copyButton.textContent = original; }, 1600);
    };

    typeSelect.addEventListener('change', populate);
    pane.querySelector('[data-compare-go]').addEventListener('click', render);
    [leftInput, rightInput].forEach(input => input.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (event.key === 'Enter') render();
    }));
    swapButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const previousLeft = leftInput.value;
      leftInput.value = rightInput.value;
      rightInput.value = previousLeft;
      render();
    });
    copyButton.addEventListener('click', copyComparison);
    pane.querySelectorAll('[data-compare-period]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activePeriod = button.dataset.comparePeriod;
      keys = presetMonthKeys(activePeriod);
      pane.querySelectorAll('[data-compare-period]').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('active', item === button));
      pane.querySelector('[data-compare-period-label]').textContent = `${activePeriod.toUpperCase()} · ${periodDescription(keys)}`;
      if (leftInput.value.trim()) render();
    }));
    populate();
  }

  setupEntityComparisonV2();
}, 0);

(() => {
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const loading = $('serverLoading');
  const message = $('serverMessage');

  function storageGet(key) {
    try { return window.sessionStorage.getItem(key); } catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  function storageSet(key, value) {
    try { window.sessionStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (_) {}
  }

  function showLoading(show) {
    if (loading) loading.classList.toggle('active', Boolean(show));
  }

  function setMessage(text, type = '') {
    if (!message) return;
    message.textContent = text || '';
    message.className = `server-message${type ? ` ${type}` : ''}`;
  }

  function switchMainTab(target, button) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dashboard-section').forEach(section => {
      section.classList.toggle('active', section.id === target);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-target]').forEach(tab => {
      const active = tab === button;
      tab.classList.toggle('active', active);
      if (active) tab.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
      else tab.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
    storageSet('geely.activeSection', target);
    try { window.scrollTo({ top: 82, behavior: 'smooth' }); }
    catch (_) { window.scrollTo(0, 82); }
    try { button?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' }); }
    catch (_) {}
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-target]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      switchMainTab(button.dataset.tabTarget, button);
    });
  });

  const hashTab = (window.location.hash || '').replace(/^#/, '');
  const savedTab = hashTab || storageGet('geely.activeSection');
  if (savedTab) {
    const button = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-target]')]
      .find(tab => tab.dataset.tabTarget === savedTab);
    if (button) switchMainTab(savedTab, button);
  }
  document.documentElement.classList.remove('no-js');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('js-ready');

  function activatePanel(kind, target) {
    document.querySelectorAll(`[data-${kind}-panel]`).forEach(panel => {
      panel.classList.toggle('active', panel.dataset[`${kind}Panel`] === target);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(`[data-${kind}-target]`).forEach(button => {
      button.classList.toggle('active', button.dataset[`${kind}Target`] === target);
    });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-target]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      activatePanel('ranking', button.dataset.rankingTarget);
    });
  });
  activatePanel('ranking', 'vn');

  const rankingSearch = $('rankingDealerSearch');
  const rankingChoices = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-dealer-choice]')];
  const rankingClear = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter-clear]');
  const rankingSelection = $('rankingDealerSelection');
  const rankingFilter = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter]');
  const rankingToggle = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter-toggle]');

  function setRankingMenu(open) {
    if (!rankingFilter || !rankingToggle) return;
    rankingFilter.classList.toggle('open', open);
    rankingToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    if (open) rankingSearch?.focus();
  }

  function normalizeSearch(value) {
    const text = String(value || '');
    const normalized = typeof text.normalize === 'function' ? text.normalize('NFD') : text;
    return normalized.replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase().trim();
  }

  function filterRankingOptions() {
    const search = normalizeSearch(rankingSearch?.value);
    let visible = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-dealer-option]').forEach(option => {
      const show = !search || (option.dataset.search || '').includes(search);
      option.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });
    document.querySelector('[data-ranking-dealer-no-results]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', visible > 0);
  }

  function filterRankingRows() {
    const selected = new Set(rankingChoices.filter(choice => choice.checked).map(choice => choice.value));
    const hasSelection = selected.size > 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-panel]').forEach(panel => {
      let visible = 0;
      const rows = panel.querySelectorAll('tr[data-ranking-dealer]');
      rows.forEach(row => {
        const show = !hasSelection || selected.has(row.dataset.rankingDealer);
        row.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
        if (show) visible += 1;
      });
      panel.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter-empty]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', rows.length === 0 || visible > 0);
    });
    if (rankingSelection) {
      rankingSelection.textContent = hasSelection
        ? `${selected.size} concessionária${selected.size === 1 ? '' : 's'} selecionada${selected.size === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
        : 'Exibindo todas as concessionárias';
    }
    rankingClear?.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasSelection);
  }

  function canvasToBlob(canvas) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => canvas.toBlob(blob => {
      if (blob) resolve(blob);
      else reject(new Error('Não foi possível gerar a imagem.'));
    }, 'image/png'));
  }

  function downloadBlob(blob, fileName) {
    if (!blob?.size) throw new Error('O arquivo gerado está vazio.');
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = fileName;
    link.rel = 'noopener';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 5000);
  }

  function shareableFile(blob, fileName) {
    if (typeof File !== 'function') return null;
    try { return new File([blob], fileName, { type: blob.type || 'application/octet-stream' }); }
    catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  function canShareFile(file) {
    if (!file || !navigator.share) return false;
    if (typeof navigator.canShare !== 'function') return true;
    try { return navigator.canShare({ files: [file] }); }
    catch (_) { return false; }
  }

  async function copyImageBlob(blob) {
    if (!navigator.clipboard?.write || typeof ClipboardItem !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('A cópia automática de imagens não está disponível neste navegador.');
    }
    await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({ 'image/png': blob })]);
  }

  let activeImagePreviewCleanup = null;
  function showImageCopyFallback(blob) {
    activeImagePreviewCleanup?.();
    const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const overlay = document.createElement('div');
    overlay.className = 'image-copy-preview';
    overlay.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'imageCopyPreviewTitle');
    overlay.innerHTML = `
      <div class="image-copy-preview-card">
        <div class="image-copy-preview-head">
          <div>
            <strong id="imageCopyPreviewTitle">Imagem pronta para copiar</strong>
            <small>O navegador bloqueou a cópia automática.</small>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="image-copy-preview-close" aria-label="Fechar">×</button>
        </div>
        <p>Clique em “Tentar copiar novamente”. Se o bloqueio continuar, clique com o botão direito na imagem (ou pressione e segure no celular) e escolha copiar.</p>
        <div class="image-copy-preview-canvas"><img alt="Prévia da imagem gerada"></div>
        <div class="image-copy-preview-actions">
          <span role="status" aria-live="polite"></span>
          <button type="button" class="export" data-image-copy-retry>Tentar copiar novamente</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    overlay.querySelector('img').src = imageUrl;
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    const onKeyDown = event => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') cleanup();
    };
    const cleanup = () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
      overlay.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
      if (activeImagePreviewCleanup === cleanup) activeImagePreviewCleanup = null;
    };
    activeImagePreviewCleanup = cleanup;
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    overlay.querySelector('.image-copy-preview-close').addEventListener('click', cleanup);
    overlay.addEventListener('click', event => {
      if (event.target === overlay) cleanup();
    });
    overlay.querySelector('[data-image-copy-retry]').addEventListener('click', async event => {
      const button = event.currentTarget;
      const status = overlay.querySelector('[role="status"]');
      try {
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = 'Copiando...';
        await copyImageBlob(blob);
        status.className = 'success';
        status.textContent = 'Imagem copiada. Use Ctrl+V para colar.';
        button.textContent = 'Imagem copiada';
        setTimeout(cleanup, 1000);
      } catch (_) {
        status.className = 'error';
        status.textContent = 'A cópia ainda está bloqueada. Copie pela própria imagem acima.';
        button.textContent = 'Tentar copiar novamente';
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    });
    overlay.querySelector('[data-image-copy-retry]').focus();
  }

  async function distributeGeneratedImage(generateBlob, fileName, options = {}) {
    const blob = await generateBlob();

    if (options.clipboardOnly) {
      try {
        await copyImageBlob(blob);
        return 'copied';
      } catch (_) {
        showImageCopyFallback(blob);
        return 'previewed';
      }
    }

    const file = shareableFile(blob, fileName);
    const mobile = /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent || '');

    if (mobile && canShareFile(file)) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'Dashboard de Qualidade Geely' });
        return 'shared';
      } catch (error) {
        if (error?.name === 'AbortError') return 'cancelled';
      }
    }

    if (options.preferDownload) {
      downloadBlob(blob, fileName);
      return 'downloaded';
    }

    if (navigator.clipboard && window.ClipboardItem) {
      try {
        await copyImageBlob(blob);
        return 'copied';
      } catch (_) {
        // Mantém compartilhamento ou download como alternativa.
      }
    }

    if (canShareFile(file)) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'Dashboard de Qualidade Geely' });
        return 'shared';
      } catch (error) {
        if (error?.name === 'AbortError') return 'cancelled';
      }
    }

    downloadBlob(blob, fileName);
    return 'downloaded';
  }

  window.geelyImageTools = { canvasToBlob, distributeGeneratedImage };

  const summaryImageDataElement = document.getElementById('summaryImageData');
  const summaryImageButton = document.querySelector('[data-summary-image]');
  const summaryImageStatus = document.querySelector('[data-summary-image-status]');
  let summaryImageData = null;
  try { summaryImageData = JSON.parse(summaryImageDataElement?.textContent || 'null'); }
  catch (_) { summaryImageData = null; }

  function fitSummaryCanvasText(context, value, maxWidth) {
    const text = String(value ?? '-');
    if (context.measureText(text).width <= maxWidth) return text;
    let shortened = text;
    while (shortened.length && context.measureText(`${shortened}…`).width > maxWidth) shortened = shortened.slice(0, -1);
    return `${shortened}…`;
  }

  function summaryValue(value, kpi) {
    if (value == null || Number.isNaN(value)) return '-';
    if (kpi === 'quantidade') return Math.round(value).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
    if (['estrelas', 'nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi)) return Number(value).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
    return `${Number(value).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}%`;
  }

  function summaryValueStatus(channel, kpi, value) {
    const objective = summaryImageData?.objetivos?.[channel]?.[kpi];
    if (value == null || Number.isNaN(value) || objective == null) return 'neutral';
    const lowerIsBetter = (summaryImageData.menor_melhor || []).includes(kpi);
    return (lowerIsBetter ? value <= objective : value >= objective) ? 'good' : 'bad';
  }

  function summaryMetricLabel(channel, kpi) {
    const label = summaryImageData.rotulos?.[channel]?.[kpi] || kpi;
    const objective = summaryImageData.objetivos?.[channel]?.[kpi];
    const displayLabel = /^q[123]$/.test(kpi) ? `MOT · ${label}` : label;
    return objective == null ? displayLabel : `${displayLabel} · Obj. ${summaryValue(objective, kpi)}`;
  }

  function summaryBrazilRegionsImage() {
    if (!summaryImageData?.geografias?.length) throw new Error('Não há informações para montar o resumo.');
    const periods = ['mtd', 'ytd'];
    const periodNames = { mtd: 'MTD', ytd: 'YTD' };
    const width = 1500;
    const margin = 24;
    const channelGap = 20;
    const channelWidth = (width - margin * 2 - channelGap) / 2;
    const metricWidth = 420;
    const periodWidth = (channelWidth - metricWidth) / periods.length;
    const titleHeight = 94;
    const geographyTitleHeight = 36;
    const channelTitleHeight = 36;
    const columnHeaderHeight = 30;
    const rowHeight = 32;
    const channelRows = Math.max(
      summaryImageData.kpis?.vn?.length || 0,
      summaryImageData.kpis?.pv?.length || 0,
    );
    const channelHeight = channelTitleHeight + columnHeaderHeight + channelRows * rowHeight;
    const geographyGap = 18;
    const geographyHeight = geographyTitleHeight + channelHeight + geographyGap;
    const legendHeight = 40;
    const height = titleHeight + summaryImageData.geografias.length * geographyHeight + legendHeight;
    const scale = height <= 14000 ? 2 : 1;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = width * scale;
    canvas.height = height * scale;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!context) throw new Error('O navegador não conseguiu preparar a imagem.');
    context.scale(scale, scale);
    context.fillStyle = '#f3f7f9';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    context.fillStyle = '#071e2a';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, titleHeight);
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.font = '800 26px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillText('Resumo Brasil e Regiões', margin, 36);
    const periodText = periods.map(period => `${periodNames[period]}: ${summaryImageData.periodos?.[period] || '-'}`).join(' · ');
    context.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.78)';
    context.font = '700 13px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillText(
      fitSummaryCanvasText(context, `Data do relatório: ${summaryImageData.data_relatorio} · ${periodText}`, width - margin * 2),
      margin,
      65,
    );

    summaryImageData.geografias.forEach((geography, geographyIndex) => {
      const top = titleHeight + geographyIndex * geographyHeight;
      const isBrazil = geographyIndex === 0;
      context.fillStyle = isBrazil ? '#ddeff7' : '#e8eef1';
      context.fillRect(margin, top, width - margin * 2, geographyTitleHeight);
      context.fillStyle = isBrazil ? '#004a73' : '#17242b';
      context.font = '800 16px Arial, sans-serif';
      context.fillText(geography.nome, margin + 12, top + 24);

      ['vn', 'pv'].forEach((channel, channelIndex) => {
        const channelX = margin + channelIndex * (channelWidth + channelGap);
        const channelY = top + geographyTitleHeight;
        const mainColor = channel === 'vn' ? '#f6d96b' : '#6d757a';
        const lightColor = channel === 'vn' ? '#fff6d7' : '#eef0f1';
        const headerText = channel === 'vn' ? '#40370d' : '#ffffff';
        context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        context.fillRect(channelX, channelY, channelWidth, channelHeight);
        context.fillStyle = mainColor;
        context.fillRect(channelX, channelY, channelWidth, channelTitleHeight);
        context.fillStyle = headerText;
        context.font = '800 15px Arial, sans-serif';
        context.fillText(channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda', channelX + 11, channelY + 24);

        const headerY = channelY + channelTitleHeight;
        context.fillStyle = lightColor;
        context.fillRect(channelX, headerY, channelWidth, columnHeaderHeight);
        context.fillStyle = '#263238';
        context.font = '800 11px Arial, sans-serif';
        context.fillText('Indicador', channelX + 9, headerY + 20);
        periods.forEach((period, periodIndex) => {
          const periodX = channelX + metricWidth + periodIndex * periodWidth;
          context.fillText(periodNames[period], periodX + 9, headerY + 20);
        });

        const kpis = summaryImageData.kpis?.[channel] || [];
        for (let rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < channelRows; rowIndex += 1) {
          const kpi = kpis[rowIndex];
          const rowY = headerY + columnHeaderHeight + rowIndex * rowHeight;
          context.fillStyle = rowIndex % 2 ? '#f8fafb' : '#ffffff';
          context.fillRect(channelX, rowY, channelWidth, rowHeight);
          if (kpi) {
            context.fillStyle = '#17242b';
            context.font = '700 11px Arial, sans-serif';
            context.fillText(
              fitSummaryCanvasText(context, summaryMetricLabel(channel, kpi), metricWidth - 18),
              channelX + 9,
              rowY + 21,
            );
            periods.forEach((period, periodIndex) => {
              const value = geography.canais?.[channel]?.[period]?.[kpi];
              const status = summaryValueStatus(channel, kpi, value);
              const periodX = channelX + metricWidth + periodIndex * periodWidth;
              context.fillStyle = status === 'good' ? '#138a45' : status === 'bad' ? '#d22929' : '#667780';
              context.font = `${status === 'neutral' ? '700' : '800'} 12px Arial, sans-serif`;
              context.fillText(
                fitSummaryCanvasText(context, summaryValue(value, kpi), periodWidth - 18),
                periodX + 9,
                rowY + 21,
              );
            });
          }
          context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
          context.beginPath();
          context.moveTo(channelX, rowY + rowHeight);
          context.lineTo(channelX + channelWidth, rowY + rowHeight);
          context.stroke();
        }

        context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
        const verticalOffsets = [
          0,
          metricWidth,
          ...periods.map((_, index) => metricWidth + periodWidth * (index + 1)),
        ];
        verticalOffsets.forEach(offset => {
          context.beginPath();
          context.moveTo(channelX + offset, headerY);
          context.lineTo(channelX + offset, channelY + channelHeight);
          context.stroke();
        });
        context.strokeRect(channelX, channelY, channelWidth, channelHeight);
      });
    });

    const legendY = height - legendHeight;
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.fillRect(0, legendY, width, legendHeight);
    context.font = '700 11px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillStyle = '#138a45';
    context.fillText('Verde: objetivo atingido', margin, legendY + 25);
    context.fillStyle = '#d22929';
    context.fillText('Vermelho: objetivo não atingido', margin + 180, legendY + 25);
    context.fillStyle = '#667780';
    context.fillText('Valores sem objetivo permanecem neutros', margin + 400, legendY + 25);
    return canvasToBlob(canvas);
  }

  if (summaryImageButton && summaryImageData) {
    summaryImageButton.dataset.summaryGeographies = String(summaryImageData.geografias.length);
    summaryImageButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const originalLabel = summaryImageButton.textContent;
      try {
        summaryImageButton.disabled = true;
        summaryImageButton.textContent = 'Gerando imagem...';
        if (summaryImageStatus) {
          summaryImageStatus.className = 'summary-image-status';
          summaryImageStatus.textContent = 'Compilando Brasil e regionais...';
        }
        const result = await distributeGeneratedImage(
          summaryBrazilRegionsImage,
          'resumo_brasil_regionais_geely.png',
          { clipboardOnly: true },
        );
        if (summaryImageStatus) {
          summaryImageStatus.className = 'summary-image-status success';
          summaryImageStatus.textContent = result === 'copied'
            ? 'Imagem copiada. Use Ctrl+V para colar.'
            : 'A prévia foi aberta para você copiar a imagem.';
        }
        summaryImageButton.textContent = result === 'copied' ? 'Imagem copiada' : 'Prévia aberta';
      } catch (error) {
        if (summaryImageStatus) {
          summaryImageStatus.className = 'summary-image-status error';
          summaryImageStatus.textContent = error.message || 'Não foi possível copiar a imagem Resumo.';
        }
        summaryImageButton.textContent = originalLabel;
      } finally {
        summaryImageButton.disabled = false;
        setTimeout(() => { summaryImageButton.textContent = originalLabel; }, 1800);
      }
    });
  }

  function rankingMtdImage() {
    const panel = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-panel].active');
    if (!panel) throw new Error('Não foi possível localizar o ranking ativo.');
    const channel = panel.dataset.rankingPanel;
    const rows = [...panel.querySelectorAll('tr[data-ranking-dealer]')]
      .filter(row => !row.classList.contains('hidden'))
      .map(row => [
        row.cells[0]?.textContent.trim() || '-',
